subject: Accounts reconciliation & executive paygate — settlement proposal
messages:
From: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@luminex.io>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@luminex.io>; accounts@luminex.io
Date: 2028-03-28T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Outstanding invoices (Feb–Mar) / tax allocation question

Hi Tessa,

We're reviewing the invoices you sent for Feb–Mar (attached). Finance has placed a temporary hold on settlement while we reconcile VAT treatment across our EU entity vs. the US entity that consumed the service. The amounts are material and hitting our month-end close.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide the invoice bundle with line-level tax codes and any evidence of place-of-supply calculations? That will speed our internal tax team's review.

Also — we received automated dunning notices which raised this to our Procurement lead; they'd like a short mutual action plan so we can clear the hold and avoid escalation. Are you able to pause automated dunning while we sort tax details?

Attachments: [attachment: Invoice_2947.pdf (PDF, 1.1MB)]

Thanks,
Oliver Grant
Head of Procurement
Luminex Therapeutics

---
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.inference.com>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@luminex.io>
Date: 2028-03-28T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Outstanding invoices (Feb–Mar) / tax allocation question

Oliver — thanks for the note and the attachment.

Short answers up front:
- Yes, we can provide a line-level breakdown with tax codes and our place-of-supply rationale.
- We're willing to pause automated dunning for 14 days while Luminex and Redwood exchange tax evidence and agree on a short plan.

Next steps I propose:
1) You share the tax team's checklist or specific evidence requests (PDF or zip).
2) I'll loop in our finance and legal to provide the invoice bundle + breakdown and a clear payment timeline.
3) If we need an executive bridge (one-off retention or limited credit) I can escalate to my finance lead and exec sponsor.

To be transparent: we typically allow a short hold but will need a clear commitment date to avoid putting the account on extended hold. If you can confirm the target resolution date, I will pause dunning and send the documents.

I'm copying our finance lead to start the internal review: Kimberly Park (kimberly.park@redwood.inference.com).

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Strategic Accounts — Commercial
Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0123

---
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.inference.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.inference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2028-04-02T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Outstanding invoices (Feb–Mar) / tax allocation question — request for executive paygate option

Team — forwarding an ask from Luminex (attached invoice). They paused payment citing cross-entity VAT allocation questions and want us to pause automated dunning. Procurement is now asking for a mutual action plan.

Why I'm escalating:
- The account is mid-commit on Dedicated; churn risk if we get into an extended credit impasse.
- Luminex is requesting a short pause on dunning and wants a formal timeline; we can provide docs but it may take their tax team 2–3 weeks.

Proposed path (low-touch, aimed at retention):
- Pause automated dunning for 14 days starting upon receipt of their tax evidence.
- Provide a consolidated invoice pack with tax codes and place-of-supply notes (we can turn this around in 48h).
- Offer an executive paygate: conditional 30-day extension on outstanding balance up to $25,000, subject to a signed payment commitment form and a confirmed resolution date.

Questions I have for Finance/Leadership:
- Can Finance enable a one-time extension up to $25k without amending contract terms?
- Marcus — do you want this presented as an exec-level goodwill offer (no discount) or should we tie it to a short retention incentive?

Attachments for internal review: [Invoice_2947.pdf] — already with the customer.

Thanks,
Tessa

---
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.inference.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.inference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2028-04-03T10:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Outstanding invoices (Feb–Mar) / tax allocation question — request for executive paygate option

Thanks for the context, Tessa. Finance is okay to provide a controlled extension under the following guardrails:

- Maximum exposure: $25,000 (one-time)
- Extension length: 30 days from signed commitment
- Condition: customer signs our Payment Commitment Form and provides the tax evidence zip within 10 business days
- We pause automated dunning for the 14-day window you proposed, but if the commitments aren't met we resume dunning and escalate collections.

Operational asks for you:
1) Get a short email from Procurement confirming the date they expect to resolve tax questions (even a best-effort date).
2) Send the Payment Commitment Form to the customer with DocuSign link once they agree.
3) Route any final approval questions to Marcus for exec sign-off if they request a larger extension or any credit.

I'll prepare the payment form and the invoice breakdown (48 hours).

-Kimberly
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

---
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.inference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.inference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2028-04-04T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Outstanding invoices (Feb–Mar) / tax allocation question — request for executive paygate option

Approve the guardrails Kimberly proposed. A few conditions from my side:
- No permanent price changes or credits; this is a time-limited liquidity accommodation to preserve the relationship.
- Document the agreement in HubSpot and our legal ops folder (ticket HL-9876).
- If Luminex asks for >30 days or >$25k exposure, escalate to me and include a churn risk assessment.

Tessa — proceed with the offer, get Procurement to confirm an expected resolution date, and send the DocuSign packet. Copy me in the outbound customer email.

Marcus Lin
Head of Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference

---
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.inference.com>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@luminex.io>
Cc: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@luminex.io>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.inference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2028-04-21T17:03:00-07:00
Subject: Executive paygate & reconciliation pack — next steps to clear invoice hold

Oliver / Sofia — thank you for your patience. Per our conversations and finance review, Redwood can offer a limited executive paygate to help you close this month while your tax team finalizes place-of-supply.

Offer summary (conditional):
- Extension: 30 days from the date the Payment Commitment Form is signed
- Exposure cap: $25,000 (one-time, no discounts)
- Conditions:
  • Luminex returns the Tax Evidence bundle within 10 business days (we will accept a single zip with the requested PDFs).
  • Payment Commitment Form executed via DocuSign (link below) stating the agreed resolution date.
  • If commitments are not met, automated dunning will resume and collections may escalate.

I've attached the reconciliation pack and the commitment form. Please:
1) Reply to confirm the date your tax team expects to resolve (e.g., 2028-04-30).
2) Complete the DocuSign packet: https://www.docusign.com/en/documents/DS-0004729
3) Send the Tax Evidence zip to accounts@redwood.inference.com (or upload to the HubSpot ticket: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/ticket/HL-9876).

Attachments: [attachment: Luminex_tax_evidence.zip (expected by customer), attachment: payment_commitment_form.docx (DocuSign packet)]

We will pause automated dunning immediately upon your reply confirming the expected resolution date, and Kimberly will send the formal DocuSign packet within 24 hours.

Best regards,
Tessa Morgan
Strategic Accounts — Commercial
Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0123
